snippet.title: Pokémon Crystal playthrough ~Longplay~
snippet.description:
This is a playthrough of Pokémon Crystal Version for the Nintendo Game Boy Colour.

Set three years after the events of the first generation, a trainer sets out on their quest in the Johto region encountering a plethora of new Pokémon in this, the enhanced version of Gold and Silver... Pokémon Crystal Version!
